emerging_themes.evidence: Proportion of total records increased from 2.10% (473/22,500) on 2026-08-02 to 3.05% (707/23,169) on 2026-08-10 at stable data volumes.
emerging_themes.risk_statement: Customers may be experiencing heightened hesitation or lack of trust regarding product quality, freshness, or return terms prior to purchasing unfamiliar items.
emerging_themes.recommended_monitor: Monitor first-time add-to-cart conversion rates and PDP engagement with product badges/reviews.

emerging_themes.risk_statement: Increased dark store stockouts or poor substitution recommendations may be causing order drops and reducing customer lifetime value.
emerging_themes.recommended_monitor: Track item stockout frequencies, substitution rejection rates, and search queries returning zero results.

emerging_themes.evidence: Grew modestly from 1.30% (293/22,500) on 2026-08-02 to 1.50% (347/23,169) on 2026-08-10 across two consecutive snapshots.
emerging_themes.risk_statement: Users browsing broader categories without finding targeted products efficiently may experience search fatigue and drop off before completing checkout.
emerging_themes.recommended_monitor: Track navigation path depth, category page filter usage, and search conversion efficiency.

new_problem_hypotheses: Recent onboarding of new user cohorts from marketing campaigns may be causing an influx of shoppers who require stronger trust cues and quality guarantees (Trial confidence).
Supply chain bottlenecks or catalog updates across local dark stores may be causing temporary fulfillment deficits for high-demand SKUs (Availability or substitution).
analysis.caveat: Data points from 2026-07-30 represent significantly smaller sample sizes (1,000–3,000 records) undergoing rapid scale-up; percentage trends are most reliable when comparing the stabilized 2026-08-02 and 2026-08-10 snapshots.
